description: This Java class 'RqlOptionParser' implements an option parser for RQL (Resource Query Language), providing methods to parse option strings into Option objects and serialize options back into strings. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearchparser' package and interacts with internal parser implementations and Option objects.

classes.name: RqlOptionParser
classes.description: A final class implementing the OptionParser interface, providing static methods to parse and unparse RQL options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given string input into a list of Option objects.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Static method that parses a string into a list of Option objects.

methods.name: unparse
methods.description: Converts a list of Option objects into a string representation suitable for parsing back to the same options.
